newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia interbank rate at 6.875 pct from 7.8125 pc.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia interbank rate at 6.875 pct from 7.8125 pc.

text.p: Tunisia's interbank rate fell to 6.8750 percent from 7.8125 percent, Central Bank officials said on Monday.
"The money market rate (TMM) is at 6.875 percent because of other liquidity. This is temporary," an official at the bank told Reuters.
The TMM had stood at 7.8125 percent since November 12, when it was cut from 8.8125 percent.
The central bank refinancing rates called "taux d'appel d'offres" and "prise de pension" remain unchanged at 6.875 and 7.875 percent respectively, the official said.
